issues.body: scripts/dispatch-claim.py loads the live policy during --self-test, resolves sparq-org/sparq as _DEFERRED_REPO, and asserts that its review_enrolment_authors is empty. This change makes that value frozenset({"jeswr"}), so the explicit assertion `sparq is NOT enrolled by this change` fails. The same test's control expects an orchestrator-class sparq PR to remain skipped. Thus this one-line policy change cannot pass the repository gate and widens the rollout without updating the executable evidence for the new target.
issues.fix_hint: Update the enrolment rollout tests and documentation in the same change so sparq is treated as an intentionally enabled target, with a positive enumerator leg driven from the shipped sparq policy and controls proving unlisted authors/classes remain refused. Run the full dispatch-claim --self-test and preserve the downstream-wiring interlock.
issues.title: Enabling sparq violates the shipped enrolment interlock/self-test

verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The policy-only expansion is not complete: it directly contradicts the shipped self-test that deliberately keeps sparq unenrolled. The repository's own gate will fail, and the diff provides no replacement evidence that the wider rollout is intentional and correctly exercised.
